tasks_completed.name: M1 #1-native mermaid
tasks_completed.description: Mirrored Cycle 6 web viewBox-normalization to native HTML template. Removed baked .mermaid svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}. Added inner #mc-scroll{overflow-x:auto} wrapper. Switched to mermaid.run().then(...) post-process — in requestAnimationFrame, locate rendered SVG, parse viewBox.baseVal.width, remove width/height attrs, set explicit style.width and max-width:none. Page-level overflow:hidden prevents WebView gesture scroll double-scroll (per codex M1 advice).
tasks_completed.rationale: Cycle 6 fixed the web path (lines 39-74) but native HTML still constrained SVG to container width. AC1 demands native parity using viewBox-based intrinsic-width — not just deleting max-width:100% (per codex Q2 + iter-1 review).

tasks_completed.name: M4 #8 mhchem (web + native)
tasks_completed.description: Web: dynamic side-effect import 'katex/contrib/mhchem' wrapped via loadKatexWithMhchem() before renderToString. Native: added <script src=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16/dist/contrib/mhchem.min.js></script> AFTER katex.min.js, BEFORE katex.render() invocation.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA spec § AC4 requires \ce{H2O} to typeset as chemistry formula. KaTeX docs require contrib/mhchem to load after katex; both web and native now conform. Pre-existing import('katex') call replaced with loadKatexWithMhchem() so any caller (block + inline) automatically registers the macro.

tasks_completed.name: B3 #13 nested ordered lists
tasks_completed.description: tryNumberedList signature changed (ctx, trimmed) → (ctx, line). New regex /^(\s*)(\d+)\.\s(.*)$/ captures leading whitespace. depth = Math.min(Math.floor(indent/2), 6) mirrors parseListItemLine (UL pattern). Continuation loop uses raw lines[ctx.index] for indent detection. numbered-list item shape extended additively with depth. RenderNumberedListBlock applies paddingLeft: item.depth * 16 (mirrors RenderListBlock at line 178). New test fixture asserts depths=[0,0,1,1,0] on a 5-item OL with mixed indents and inline link in item[1].
tasks_completed.rationale: BA spec § AC10 + codex iter-1 Q1 ratification (most isolated B-item). Existing 7 fixtures PASS unchanged because depth field is purely additive — flat OL fixtures still produce depth=0.
